# Codex Studio 0.1.31
Compatibility fixes for the latest ChatGPT desktop update.
- Remove the dark decorative strip above the conversation composer in ChatGPT 26.1013. - Keep the native sidebar mode label from appearing twice. - Smooth Home project rail corners and preserve the project pill border and focus ring without a cut-off backing. - Respect Reduce Transparency consistently in sidebar, summary, response backing and search surfaces. - Update DreamSkin to 1.9.25 so Studio refreshes older installed runtimes and cached build assets. - Run Swift and browser runtime regression tests before signed release packaging.
Existing themes, drafts, favorites and appearance settings are preserved.
